headline: Home Depot missed EPS estimates and cut its FY2025 profit outlook, citing no storms, consumer uncertainty and housing pressure.
guidance_note: Cut FY2025 adj EPS outlook on Q4 pressure from reduced storms, consumer uncertainty, housing softness and GMS inclusion; sales outlook nudged up with GMS.
key_messages: US comps +0.1% (total +0.2%): comparable transactions -1.6%, average ticket +1.8%.
Adj EPS $3.74 missed (~$3.84 consensus); Decker blamed lack of storms plus consumer uncertainty and housing pressure.
Sales +2.8% to $41.4bn, including ~$900m from GMS (about eight weeks).
Shares fell roughly 4-6% intraday on the miss and outlook cut.

consumer.big_ticket: Transactions over $1,000 +2.3%, but larger projects pressured by affordability and housing uncertainty.
consumer.pricing: Ticket gains reflected mix and modest price increases.

macro_read: Weak housing turnover and elevated rates are capping home improvement; absent storm-repair demand, the category is essentially flat.

sources.label: FMP: Home Depot shares slip as adjusted earnings miss
